The new DIRTY BOY preamp, is powered by T.A.E. technology (proprietary tube amp. emulation developed by Danny Gomez, engineer, musical director and session guitarist). Based on the classic amplifier designed by Alex Saraceno and used by legendary Blues Saraceno, DIRTY BOY is a fully analog amplifier simulator for LINE connection, a highly detailed preamp to your amp´s FX LOOP, or even an impressive tube-sounding booster/overdrive to your amp´s INPUT. Feat: Powered by T.A.E. technology Variac simulator Preamp Output Speaker Emulated Output (closed-back w/ 4 x 12 “Greenback”) Specs: Input impedance: 1 MOhms. Output Impedance: 6.5 KOhms. Power supply: 9V external AC-DC adaptor (CENTER NEGATIVE) Dimensions (mm): 120 x 90 x 50 Weight: 400gr. Developed by Danny Gomez and handcrafted in Europe, T.A.E. technology revolutionizes guitar recording and live shows in an ultra-compact design with amazing results. Used on pedalboards and studios worldwide by some of the finest players and producers. Available to guitarists and bassists needing both a professional alternative to their amplifiers and/or a responsive backup to their regular rig on an ultra-lightweight package with a real analog experience. Return to shop open Dirty Boy® Preamp 19.99 Dirty Boy® Preamp quantity DEMO IN GENOME INTRO PEDAL Drive Preamp About The Dirty Boy® Preamp Introducing the Dirty Boy® Preamp — reborn inside GENOME as a PEDAL-Ai™ Component. Built on Alex Saraceno’s iconic design, it’s more than a preamp: it’s a weapon. Expect snarling tube-style grit, touch-sensitive dynamics, and the same DNA that fueled Blues Saraceno’s legendary tones. From searing boosts to standalone amp voice to feral overdrive, the Dirty Boy® Preamp doesn’t play nice—it dominates. The control set is lean but lethal. Gain pushes from edge-of-breakup crunch to full-blown filth, while Volume asserts your overall output with authority. Tone sweeps from smoky warmth to razor-cut bite, letting you carve through any mix. The Variac is where things get dangerous—cranked it’s bold and articulate, but roll it back and the voltage collapses into sagging, fuzz-soaked chaos. Flip on 12v Mode and the whole circuit breathes deeper, with bigger headroom and an even wilder Variac response. And when you need to go direct, the built-in Emulated Out with its closed-back 4×12 Greenback cab-sim delivers instant, mix-ready firepower. The Dirty Boy Preamp isn’t here to play nice — it’s Dirty Boy® unleashed in GENOME. Born from Alex Saraceno’s iconic circuit and bred for mayhem, it delivers snarling grit, sagging chaos, and unapologetic power. This is the sound of Dirty Boy®, weaponized. Dirty Boy® DNA — the art of controlled chaos. Features GENOME PEDAL-Ai™ Component created with Dirty Boy® Based on Alex Saraceno’s legendary design Variac control for authentic sag and fuzzed-out chaos Tone shaping from dark and smoky to sharp and cutting 12v Mode for enhanced headroom and hotter Variac response Built-in cab-sim output emulating a closed-back 4×12 outfitted with Greenbacks Loaded with an arsenal of Component-level presets for immediate creative potential from the get-go Dirty Boy® Preamp 19.99 Dirty Boy® Preamp quantity This product is a GENOME Component and as such requires a Two notes account and a full license to GENOME in order for the component to be used in a full-featured state.
